prompt: On the search page (search.html), make the "Search stories" box suggest story titles in a list right below it while the reader types. Suggest every title that contains the typed text, ignoring case. The titles are "Crossing the Tatras in October" (articles/tatras-in-october.html), "Breaking in leather boots" (articles/breaking-in-boots.html) and "Five lakes in one day" (articles/tatras-in-october.html#day-two). Picking a suggestion puts its title in the box; the Search button still submits as it does now. Keep the label "Search stories". Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in this site, no libraries. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
